source_license_verification.evidence: Academic research-only license enforced; commercial use blocked.

source_checksum_integrity.evidence: SHA-256 verification implemented for all registered sources and raw files.

parent_combined_overlap_prevention.evidence: Automatic overlap risk detection blocks appending parent datasets to NF-UQ-NIDS-v2.

train_test_isolation.evidence: Group-aware and independent source holdout splitting guarantees 0% cross-split leakage.

label_taxonomy_and_leakage_guards.evidence: TargetLeakageError raised when labels, sources, or split metadata enter predictors.

feature_availability_and_parity.evidence: Deployable feature spec strictly isolates 14 directly available and derivable FlowEvent v1 features.

signed_dataset_manifests.evidence: Cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signatures generated and verified on all manifests.

training_only_preprocessing.evidence: Imputers and scalers fitted strictly on training split; zero validation/test contamination.

seven_isp_federated_partitions.evidence: Seven simulated ISP clients partitioned under IID, moderate non-IID, and strong non-IID Dirichlet distributions.

full_dataset_offline_acquisition.evidence: 12 GiB full dataset acquisition requires explicit user command (exceeds default 1 GiB zero-cost cap). Synthetic fixture verified end-to-end.
